🇩🇪 Germany · 2 people × €80,000 a year · 12 months EOR (Deel): €210,622 fee €538 per person a month ($599 list price, ECB rate of 28 Oct 2026) Own entity on Deel Payroll: €215,710 setup €2,475 + closing €4,250 · €717 a month + €26 per person a month 7 weeks to set up, on EOR meanwhile: €2,152 Salary + contributions, identical either way: €197,709 💡 For 2 people over 12 months EOR is cheaper by ~€5,087. An entity pays off from 3 people (over 12 months). With 2 people it pays off after 29 months. Every line has a source (/sources). Not priced, and all in the EOR's favour: your team's own time on the entity, the months a liquidation takes, and the misclassification and permanent-establishment risk an EOR carries for you. 📝 Deel's guide still shows long-term care rate: 1.7%; the official figure since 1 Jan 2026 is 1.8% (source). 📝 Deel's guide still shows insolvency levy: 0.06%; the official figure since 1 Jan 2026 is 0.15% (source).

🇧🇬 Bulgaria · €60,000 gross a year Employer cost: €65,222 a year · €5,435 a month On top of salary: +€5,222 a year (8.7%) • State pension 8.22%, capped — €2,269 • Universal pension fund 2.8%, capped — €773 • Sickness and maternity 2.1%, capped — €580 • Unemployment 0.6%, capped — €166 • Health insurance 4.8%, capped — €1,325 • Work accident (IT, office) ~0.4%, capped — €110 2026 rates, in force since 1 Jan 2026. Payslip lines rounded to the cent, shown in whole units. Contribution ceiling from 1 Aug 2026, applied to every month. ~ typical rate, depends on the employer. 📝 Deel's guide still shows maximum insurable income: 3,750 BGN/mo; the official figure since 1 Aug 2026 is €2,300/mo (source).
